SMCT.description: Settlement Analysis Control Data (SMCT). A single-instance control record (key is always 1) toggling whether concurrent forces are computed for plate and link elements during settlement analysis.

CONCURRENT_CALC.description: Plate Concurrent Force: when true, concurrent forces for plate elements are calculated during settlement analysis; false disables it.

CONCURRENT_LINK.description: Elastic/General Links Concurrent Force: when true, concurrent forces for elastic and general link elements are calculated; false disables it.
